notes: Deterministic Barabási–Albert preferential-attachment graph (n=50, m=2, seed=0). The hub-dominated topology means the canonical Leiden result is a hub-and-satellite cut: the high-degree 'hub' nodes (degree ≥ 6) form one community, the low-degree 'periphery' nodes another, with a thin 'intermediate' layer. The partition file is generated by tools/gen_ba_small.py --emit-partition; placeholder value above is an estimate and will be locked in by the Phase 3 reference-partition verification (T035 / T116a).
